routes.name: Visa-Exempt Entry
routes.summary: Citizens of about 60 listed countries can enter without a visa for 14, 30 or 90 days. Most of Europe, the US, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Japan and Korea get 90 days.

other: Passport valid at least 6 months from entry date
Confirmed return or onward ticket
Stay cannot be extended, except Canadian and UK citizens who may extend 90 days up to 180
Singapore and Malaysia get 30 days. Thailand, Brunei and the Philippines get 14 days with hotel booking and funds proof, listed until July 31, 2027
Check the official list for your passport, some have place-of-birth limits

stay.note: 90 days for most listed countries, 30 or 14 days for some.

steps: Check your passport on the official list
Fill out the Taiwan Arrival Card online
Show your return ticket at the border

routes.name: Taiwan Arrival Card
routes.summary: Everyone arriving, including visa-exempt travelers, fills out the online arrival card. Do it within seven days before you land.
steps: Fill it out within 7 days before arrival

routes.name: Landing Visa (emergency or temporary passports)
routes.summary: For people holding emergency or temporary passports from visa-exempt countries (not the US). Gets you 30 days, no extension.

other: Passport valid more than 6 months
Confirmed onward ticket
No criminal record concerns

routes.name: Employment Gold Card
routes.summary: Four-in-one open work permit, visa and resident card for foreign professionals in 12 fields. Lets you work for any employer for up to 3 years.

income.note: Salary route in certain fields only

other: Apply under one field only. Fields: architecture, arts and culture, digital, economy, education, finance, national defense, science and technology, law, sports, biotechnology, environment
Criteria differ by field, use the official Qualification Check
Fees not confirmed

stay.note: Up to 3 years. Renewal rules not confirmed.

routes.name: Foreign Professional Work Permit and Visa
routes.summary: Employer-sponsored permit for specialized or technical jobs. You need a degree plus experience, a company transfer, or certified expertise.

income.note: Minimum average monthly salary, unless other rules apply

other: Master's degree, or bachelor's plus more than 2 years of experience, or more than 1 year at a multinational then transferred, or 5+ years of expertise
Permit duration and fees not confirmed

sources.label: EZ Work Taiwan, wages and experience

routes.name: Taiwan Entrepreneur Visa
routes.summary: Two-year visa for founders who meet one of eight criteria, like NT$2 million in funding, an incubator recommendation, a patent or a competition award. Apply online.

investment.note: Criterion VIII, in an enterprise you run. Funding route needs NT$2 million.

other: Meet at least one of eight criteria
Teams must be fewer than 3 people
Extension up to 2 years each: sales NT$3 million, or expenses NT$1 million, or 3 full-time Taiwanese staff

steps: Register on the NIA Foreign Professionals Online Application Platform

routes.name: Student Visa
routes.summary: Resident visa for degree or language study at a Taiwan school. Details were not confirmed from an official page.

other: Official page unreachable, details not confirmed

routes.name: Working Holiday Visa
routes.summary: Young people from 17 partner countries can travel and work in Taiwan. Age limits, quotas and funds rules were not confirmed.

other: Age, quota and funds rules vary by country, check the official pages

routes.name: Permanent Residence (APRC)
routes.summary: General route is 5 straight years of legal residence with 183+ days a year. Professionals can qualify in 3 years, spouses of Taiwanese in 10 years total.

other: Clean police record
Spouses of Taiwan nationals: 10 years total, 183+ days a year for the latest 5
Specialist professionals: 3 years, or 1 year with NT$6,000,000 income
No language test in the guidelines

savings.note: Alternative: Taiwan assets for over a year. Or income above twice the minimum wage.

routes.processing: 14 days from case officer receipt, not counting extras like interviews.

routes.name: Naturalization
routes.summary: 5 years of legal residence with 183+ days a year, basic Mandarin and civic knowledge. Marriage to a Taiwanese citizen, a Taiwanese parent or birth in Taiwan cut it to 3 years.

eligibility.language: Basic Mandarin and knowledge of citizen rights and duties
other: Clean police record
Enough property or skills to support yourself
Shorter 3-year route for marriage, parent a citizen, Taiwan-born, or caring for citizen children
10+ years of residence route also exists, and high-level professionals can use 2 or 5 years

citizenship.note: Foreign applicants must usually prove loss of original nationality within one year of approval. Exemptions exist for some professionals and special contributors. Citizenship also passes automatically by descent from a Taiwanese parent.
